subject: *: Deprecated and always set to ON tidb_enable_global_index (#56169)
summary: Removes the `tidb_enable_global_index` feature gate from DDL by deleting `SessionVars.EnableGlobalIndex` and all associated checks; keeps the sysvar as a deprecated compatibility no-op (warns on OFF) while enforcing explicit `GLOBAL` for partitioned unique/PK indexes that don’t cover all partitioning columns.
